title: Senior Consultant - Quality Assurance
description:
WSP is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Lead to establish and lead practical QA practices for our Digital Environment development team. This hands\-on role will define quality strategy, improve delivery processes, guide testing activities, and promote shared ownership of quality across the software development lifecycle.


The team delivers data management, software development, and web\-based weather information services for internal and external clients using cloud technologies and Agile delivery practices.


  
Quality Strategy, Governance \& Process Leadership
  

* Define and implement a practical QA strategy, operating model, standards, roadmap, and supporting templates.
* Assess current practices, identify quality risks and process gaps, and prioritize measurable improvements.
* Establish quality gates, release\-readiness practices, defect workflows, and test evidence expectations.

Test Planning, Automation \& Execution
  

* Lead risk\-based test planning for features, integrations, data workflows, and production releases.
* Perform and oversee manual and automated testing across web, API, data\-processing, and mobile solutions.
* Develop and maintain the team’s test automation approach, including standards and CI/CD integration.
* Track defects and quality risks, support timely resolution, and turn findings into process improvements.

Team Leadership \& Capability Development
  

* Provide technical direction, mentoring, and coordination for QA professionals and others performing testing.
* Help shape QA roles, responsibilities, recruitment, onboarding, and future team structure.

Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement
  

* Participate in Agile planning, refinement, stand\-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide evidence\-based recommendations on product quality, release readiness, and material risks.
* Promote shared ownership of quality rather than treating QA as a final testing step.

  
**•** 7\+ years of software QA experience, including senior, lead, or equivalent responsibilities.


**•** Experience defining and improving QA processes, standards, governance, measures, and team practices.


**•** Experience leading or mentoring QA professionals; formal supervisory experience is an asset.


**•** Strong knowledge of testing methods, risk\-based testing, defect management, root\-cause analysis, and quality engineering.


**•** Hands\-on test automation experience using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.


**•** Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, data\-processing workflows, and CI/CD quality controls.


**•** Strong analytical, facilitation, and communication, and skills.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**

**•** Experience with cloud services, especially Amazon Web Services, and 24/7 operational systems.


**•** Experience with performance, reliability, accessibility, security, mobile, or usability testing.


**•** Experience testing data\-intensive, geospatial, environmental, weather, or other operationally critical systems.


**BGV:**  

• Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  

• Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
Job Description:

**Job Title: Tester (Automation \& Manual)**

**Location: Noida**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time**

Experience: 4\-5 Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **QA Engineer** who is skilled in both **manual and automation testing**. You will work closely with our development team to ensure high\-quality releases through effective testing processes, automation frameworks, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and execute **manual and automated test cases** for web and mobile applications.
* Understand project requirements and identify **test scenarios**, **test data**, and **test coverage**.
* Perform **functional, regression, smoke, and integration testing**.
* Write and maintain **automation scripts** using tools such as **Selenium / Playwright / Cypress / Appium** (as applicable).
* Detect, document, and track defects using tools like **JIRA / Bugzilla / Azure DevOps**.
* Participate in **code reviews, sprint planning, and daily standups** to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.
* Ensure adherence to **QA standards and best practices**.
* Work collaboratively with developers and product teams to reproduce issues and validate fixes.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, IT, or a related field**.
* **1–3 years** of experience in **software testing** (manual \+ automation).
* Strong understanding of **STLC, SDLC**, and **defect management process**.
* Hands\-on experience with automation tools such as **Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or Appium**.
* Knowledge of **test frameworks** (JUnit, TestNG, PyTest, etc.) and **CI/CD integration** (Jenkins, GitLab, etc.).
* Experience with **API testing** using **Postman, RestAssured, or similar tools**.
* Good understanding of **database testing** (writing SQL queries).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in **performance or security testing**.
* Familiarity with **version control systems** (Git).
* Knowledge of **Agile / Scrum methodologies**.

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to work with a talented and collaborative team.
* Exposure to modern automation frameworks and tools.
* Dynamic and growth\-oriented work culture.

Job Type: Full\-time

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

title: QA Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Junior / Associate QA Automation Engineer (1 Year Experience)  
**Location:** \[Noida, India]  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Role Summary**  
We are looking for an Associate QA Automation Engineer with **1 year of hands\-on experience** in software testing and test automation. In this role, you will work closely with development and QA teams to write automated test scripts, execute test suites, maintain existing test frameworks, and perform manual testing when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Test Automation \& Execution:** Write, maintain, and execute automated UI/API test scripts using framework tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright).
* **Test Case Design:** Review functional specifications, write structured test cases, and identify test scenarios suitable for automation.
* **Manual \& Regression Testing:** Perform routine regression, smoke, and functional manual testing during sprint cycles.
* **Bug Tracking \& Reporting:** Log, track, and verify defects using Jira or similar tools, providing clear steps to reproduce.
* **CI/CD Integration:** Trigger and monitor automated test runs within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
* **Collaboration:** Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and work alongside developers to resolve defects early.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 1 year of software testing experience with exposure to test automation.
* **Programming Skills:** Foundational coding skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* **Automation Tools:** Hands\-on experience with at least one UI framework (Selenium Webdriver, Cypress, Playwright) or API testing tool (Postman, REST Assured).
* **Database \& SQL:** Basic ability to write simple SQL queries for data validation.
* **Tools \& Version Control:** Familiarity with Git, Jira, and TestRail/Zephyr.

Pay: ₹120,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
